description: The plot illustrates the relative change in performance across different layer groupings for various KV cache compression methods applied to Mistral-7B-v0.2-Instruct using SnapKV as the pruning method. The x-axis represents the layer groupings—Layer1-4, Layer5-12, Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29-32—while the y-axis shows the relative change in performance, ranging from -25% to 5%. The gray dashed line, labeled "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit," remains constant at 0% across all layers, serving as a reference point. The yellow line, representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit," starts at approximately 0%, dips slightly to around -5% at Layer13-20, and then recovers to 0% by Layer29-32, showing a relatively stable trend. The red line, "LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit," follows a similar pattern, beginning at 0%, dropping to about -10% at Layer13-20, and returning to 0% at Layer29-32. The light blue line, "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit," starts at -2%, decreases to -15% at Layer13-20, and then rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line, "RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit," begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods exhibit more stability, with smaller fluctuations, while the RULER4k methods show more pronounced declines, particularly in the middle layers, indicating greater sensitivity to layer-specific compression effects.

The plot illustrates the relative change across different layer groupings, with the x-axis labeled 'Layer' and the y-axis labeled 'Relative Change'. The gray dashed line represents the baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit, which remains constant at 0% across all layers. The yellow line (LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit) shows a steady trend, with a slight dip to approximately -5% at Layer13-20 before returning to 0%. The red line (LB-Avg of 1×tokens,16-bit) follows a similar pattern, dipping to -10% at Layer13-20 and recovering to 0% by Layer29-32. The light blue line (RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit) starts at -2%, dips to -15% at Layer13-20, and rises back to -2% by Layer29-32. The dark blue line (RULER4k of 1×tokens,16-bit) begins at -4%, drops sharply to -30% at Layer13-20, and recovers to -5% by Layer29-32. Overall, the LB-Avg methods demonstrate more stability compared to the RULER4k methods, which exhibit sharper declines at intermediate layers.
